skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and manage business operations in commercial enterprises, including planning, execution, and monitoring business strategies.
Understand and analyze international trade activities, including export-import processes, international trade agreements, and market entry strategies.
Understand and manage customs regulations and procedures, including customs declaration, inspection, and tariff and clearance rules.
Negotiate and communicate effectively in business transactions, draft and review transaction documents, and deliver business presentations.
Extract, synthesize, analyze, and evaluate business data and information to solve practical problems in international trade and customs.
Manage business activities, develop, implement, and control international trade strategies.
Evaluate the economic and social impacts of customs regulations and manage customs administration.
Demonstrate self-reliance and responsibility in independent work and group projects.
Form and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.

prerequisite_courses: Essential courses in the Commercial Business program
